about: Redington Limited distributes information technology, mobility, and other technology products in India, the Middle East, Turkey, Africa, and South Asian countries. It provides AI and automation, software applications, security, digital printing, data and analytics, infrastructure, 3D printing, network modernization, cyber security, solar, gaming, AR and VR, home automation, wearables, and displays; and firewalls, access service edge, endpoint security, and identity and access management solution
